role: District Representative · Zamboanga del Sur, 1st District
profileLabel: Center-left economics (low confidence, co-authored only); no other dimension scored
summary: Zamboanga del Sur 1st District representative with 95 principal-authored bills. The rubric-relevant record is entirely co-authored: institutionalized DSWD crisis assistance, an expanded electricity lifeline rate, an OFW reintegration program, condonation of Basilan electric cooperative obligations, estate tax amnesty and travel-tax abolition.
caveat: Co-authored bills only; they do not prove personal endorsement of each provision. Bill-based only.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Co-authored institutionalized DSWD crisis assistance (-2), expanded electricity lifeline rate (-2) and an OFW reintegration program (-2). Estate tax amnesty and travel-tax abolition are neutral. Three issues, co-authored only.
